messages.subject: MSstats 3.5.1 is released in msstats.org
parts:
Dear MSstats users,

MSstats 3.5.1 is available in msstats.org

         - fix the bug for summaryMethod='logOfSum' in dataProcess. filterLogOfSum=TRUE (default) will remove any run that has any missing value with summaryMethod='logOfSum'.

Please let us know if you have any difficulty.
- MSstats developers
